title: Nowhere to Stay
paragraphs: At last, Mary and Joseph reached Bethlehem. The little town was packed with visitors, all there to be counted. Joseph knocked on doors and found every place full. Mary was tired, and her baby was about to come. Luke tells us there was no room for them in the guest-place (the inn). Many scholars think it may have been the upper guest room of a family house, with animals sheltered on the ground floor, so the family may have ended up among the animals and their feed troughs. Wherever it was, it wasn't a palace. The King of kings came to the world with no place booked. That means he understands what it's like to be turned away.
wonder: I wonder how it feels to knock and find no room?
prayer: God, open our doors and our hearts to everyone who has nowhere to stay tonight. Amen.
alt: A couple stand at a row of closed doors at night, with a low stable glowing at the end of the street.
translation: Retold in our own words, following the World English Bible.
